chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

'God never sent a prophet until He took from him three characteristics: the acknowledgement of His Lordship, the renouncing of rivals (idols), and that God advances whatever He wills and delays whatever He wills.'

key_terms.الْأَنْدَادِ: Rivals, equals, idols — anything set up as a partner or equivalent to God
key_terms.الْبَدَاءُ: Bada' — the doctrine that God may alter or revise His decrees as He wills, an important Shia theological concept
key_terms.الْعُبُودِيَّةِ: Servitude/acknowledgement of Lordship — the recognition that God alone is the master and ruler

ai.seo_question: What three commitments did every prophet make before being sent by God according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) teaches that every prophet was commissioned by God only after affirming three foundational commitments: recognizing God's exclusive Lordship (tawhid in practice), rejecting all rivals to God (shirk), and accepting the doctrine of Bada' — that God freely advances or delays matters according to His will. This connects prophethood directly to the doctrine of divine freedom over decrees, a cornerstone of Shia theology.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> did not Send a Prophet<sup>as</sup> until He<sup>azwj</sup> Took three characteristics to be upon him<sup>as</sup> – The acknowledgement to Him<sup>azwj</sup> of His<sup>azwj</sup> Lordship, and Keeping away from the idols, and that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Brings forwards whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires to, and Delays whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires to’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated from Ali from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Allah did not send any messenger without three conditions. (a) Acknowledgement of being His servant and worshipper (b) To acknowledge that there is nothing like Him and (c) that Allah may bring forwards whatever He would so will and takes backwards whatever He would so will.”
